name: hud-explain-links-visual
description: HUD explanations and entity links (#2169): a union-style lawsuit settlement raises a live work-stoppage chip under the top bar, a player hovers it with the real pointer and the explainable() tooltip shows its effect and end time as the game clock; then the player opens the activity log from the top bar and clicks the employee named by a crew entry, if one has been raised by then, which opens the inspector on that employee. All by real clicks.

steps.description: Staffed site with plenty of cash for the settlement.
Test hook: `event fire` has no UI control and none is intended. Raises the lawsuit whose second option ends in a 12 hour work stoppage.

expect.note: Option 1 of lawsuit_superpowers costs money and starts a work stoppage modifier.

steps.description: Answer the lawsuit by clicking its second option; the work stoppage becomes a chip in the strip under the top bar.

expect.note: The chip receives pointer events although its strip is click-through; the tooltip names the effect and the end time.

steps.description: Hover the work-stoppage chip with the real pointer; the explanation tooltip opens beside it and is screenshotted.
Let the crew work so the log may collect an entry naming an employee. A tick command stops early when a random event lands, hence either.

expect.note: Closest viable: no console command raises a crew notification on demand, so the employee link click is conditional on such an entry existing. The row shows the game clock either way.

steps.description: Open the activity log from the top bar bell, screenshot the rows with their game-clock times, and click the employee link of a crew entry when one exists; the inspector opens on that employee.
